notes.title: The Lost Soul Available Now!
notes.content:
The Lost Soul is an arcade difficulty-focused platformer , made in a minimalist style. 13 different levels, each of which contain it’s own unique soundtrack, checkpoint system, as well as many secrets.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/969130/][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33842806/68834e6cd560999a4da98a6f17889988013cbce1.jpg[/img][/url]

notes.title: The Lost Soul - Pre-Release Build #3314
notes.content:
[h1]General[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added new soundtracks
[*] Added new sounds
[*] Added new UI elements
[*] Changed the soundtrack playback system, now the soundtracks are played in random order, without repeating
[/list]

[h1]Gameplay[/h1]
[list]
[*] The amount of lives on the different difficulties increased from 100/70/30 to 250/100/40
[*] Partially changed level 11 structure
[/list]

[h1]Bugfixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed incorrect display of the walkthrough time in the results table
[*] Fixed incorrect display of player name
[*] Fixed game colliders at levels 3 and 7
[*] Fixed getting Steam achievements
[/list]
